name: Werdana Social Login: Google & Yandex Auth
author: werdana

sections.description:
Werdana Social Login is a lightweight and secure plugin that allows your visitors to register and log in to your WordPress site using their Google or Yandex accounts.

Stop losing users because of long registration forms! This plugin integrates seamlessly with the standard WordPress user system, WooCommerce, and Tourmaster without requiring third-party servers.

Russian Version

Плагин позволяет входить через Google и Яндекс. Простая настройка в админке. Полная поддержка Tourmaster и кастомных полей.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the werdana-social-auth folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> Werdana Auth to configure your API keys.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store my users’ passwords?

No. The plugin uses OAuth2, which means it never sees or stores user passwords from Google or Yandex.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Fixed CSS specificity issues: buttons now display perfectly even with aggressive theme styles (like Tourmaster).
  • Added JS injection method for seamless integration into custom popup forms.
  • Updated stylesheet versioning to clear browser cache automatically.

1.0.4

  • Separated CSS styles from PHP into a dedicated stylesheet (werdana-style.css) to meet WordPress.org coding standards.
  • Added detailed step-by-step setup guides for Google and Yandex directly in the admin panel.
  • Improved security checks and error handling for remote API requests.
  • Fully prepared for localization.

1.0.3

  • Fixed NonceVerification warnings for OAuth callback.
  • Removed non-English characters from main description to pass automated checks.
